integrity: The mathematical theorem has an analytic proof and a standalone rational-arithmetic verifier; no external or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform derangements, distinct j,k>=2, j+k<=n only; asymptotic at fixed j,k. Earlier general factorial moments already imply the exact covariance formula; priority of strict parity inequality is subject to historical literature. Finite tests are not proof.
title: Parity law and factorial decay for distinct cycle-count covariances in uniform derangements
